answer.label: Not Clarke — Isaac Asimov
answer.sourceLine: Clive Lawrence’s interview profile quotes Isaac Asimov saying these exact words in the Daily Pilot, 13 April 1974, page 23. We downloaded and visually inspected that newspaper page; Wikiquote’s disputed Clarke entry also notes the competing Asimov credit. This establishes Asimov’s documented use, not the first-ever utterance.
